description: Flat metadata schema for individual patient records from a prostate cancer clinical registry capturing radiotherapy planning, delivery, adverse events, and longitudinal outcomes.

patient_record_id.descr: Unique anonymized identifier for the individual patient record within the registry.

site_code.descr: Registry site, hospital, or treating center code where the patient was managed.

patient_age_years.descr: Age at diagnosis or registry enrollment in years.

sex.descr: Biological sex of the patient; expected value is typically 'male' for this cohort.

ethnicity.descr: Patient ethnicity/race as recorded in the registry using a controlled vocabulary or local coding system.

body_mass_index_kg_m2.descr: Body mass index at baseline in kg/m^2.

smoking_status.descr: Smoking status at baseline, for example never, former, or current.

comorbidity_index.descr: Overall comorbidity burden score, such as Charlson Comorbidity Index, if available.

diabetes_mellitus.descr: Whether the patient has diabetes mellitus at baseline.

hypertension.descr: Whether the patient has hypertension at baseline.

cardiovascular_disease.descr: Whether the patient has known cardiovascular disease at baseline.

baseline_psa_ng_ml.descr: Baseline prostate-specific antigen (PSA) level in ng/mL.

gleason_score.descr: Gleason score at diagnosis, for example 6, 7, 8, 9, or 10.

grade_group.descr: ISUP Grade Group at diagnosis, typically 1 to 5.

clinical_t_stage.descr: Clinical T stage at diagnosis, for example cT1c, cT2a, cT3b.

nodal_status.descr: Clinical nodal status at diagnosis, for example N0, N1, or NX.

metastatic_status.descr: Metastatic status at diagnosis, for example M0, M1, or MX.

risk_category.descr: Prostate cancer risk group, for example low, intermediate, high, or very high.

radiotherapy_intent.descr: Treatment intent of radiotherapy, for example curative, adjuvant, salvage, or palliative.

radiotherapy_start_date.descr: Date of first radiotherapy fraction or treatment initiation.

radiotherapy_end_date.descr: Date of final radiotherapy fraction or treatment completion.

radiotherapy_modality.descr: Radiotherapy modality used, for example 3D-CRT, IMRT, VMAT, SBRT, or proton therapy.

treatment_setting.descr: Treatment setting such as definitive, postoperative adjuvant, or salvage.

total_prescribed_dose_gy.descr: Total prescribed radiotherapy dose in Gray (Gy).

dose_per_fraction_gy.descr: Dose delivered per fraction in Gray (Gy).

fractionation_schedule.descr: Fractionation scheme as a coded string, for example conventional, moderate hypofractionation, or ultrahypofractionation.

target_volume_prostate.descr: Whether the prostate gland was included in the target volume.

target_volume_seminal_vesicles.descr: Whether seminal vesicles were included in the target volume.

target_volume_pelvic_nodes.descr: Whether pelvic lymph nodes were included in the target volume.

target_volume_boost.descr: Whether a boost target volume was treated.

planned_target_volume_cc.descr: Planned target volume size in cubic centimeters (cc), if recorded.

androgen_deprivation_therapy_used.descr: Whether androgen deprivation therapy was given with radiotherapy.

androgen_deprivation_start_date.descr: Date androgen deprivation therapy was started, if applicable.

androgen_deprivation_duration_months.descr: Duration of androgen deprivation therapy in months.

pre_treatment_psa_ng_ml.descr: PSA level immediately before radiotherapy or at treatment planning, in ng/mL.

session_attendance_rate_pct.descr: Percentage of scheduled radiotherapy sessions attended/completed, expressed as 0 to 100.

missed_sessions_count.descr: Number of planned treatment sessions missed.

treatment_break_days.descr: Total number of unplanned days treatment was interrupted.

acute_toxicity_present.descr: Whether any acute treatment-related toxicity was documented during or shortly after radiotherapy.

acute_toxicity_grade.descr: Maximum acute toxicity grade recorded, typically using CTCAE or RTOG grading.

late_toxicity_present.descr: Whether any late treatment-related toxicity was documented at follow-up.

late_toxicity_grade.descr: Maximum late toxicity grade recorded, typically using CTCAE or RTOG grading.

toxicity_type.descr: Primary toxicity category, for example genitourinary, gastrointestinal, sexual, or skin.

adverse_reaction_description.descr: Free-text or coded description of the adverse reaction or complication.

follow_up_date.descr: Date of the follow-up assessment corresponding to outcome capture.

follow_up_months.descr: Time from start of radiotherapy to follow-up assessment in months.

disease_status_at_follow_up.descr: Disease status at follow-up, for example no evidence of disease, biochemical recurrence, local recurrence, metastatic progression, or deceased.

psa_at_follow_up_ng_ml.descr: PSA measured at follow-up in ng/mL.

overall_survival_status.descr: Vital status at follow-up, for example alive or dead.

overall_survival_months.descr: Overall survival time in months from diagnosis or treatment start, depending on registry convention.

quality_of_life_score.descr: Overall quality-of-life score from a validated instrument, if recorded, such as EPIC or EORTC; document the instrument in registry documentation.

quality_of_life_instrument.descr: Name of the quality-of-life instrument used, for example EPIC-26, EORTC QLQ-C30, or EQ-5D.

patient_reported_urinary_bother.descr: Patient-reported urinary symptom burden score or category, if available.

patient_reported_bowel_bother.descr: Patient-reported bowel symptom burden score or category, if available.

patient_reported_sexual_bother.descr: Patient-reported sexual symptom burden score or category, if available.
